short: Variation in adjusted map heights across words

lean.name: Formalism.RankGapBounds.WeightedMeanData.Data.HComp
lean.plain: Variation in adjusted map heights across words
lean.note: Two words in the same translate can have different map heights and different auxiliary level primes. The bound controls the variation of their combined quantity $h(u)+\sum_t a_t\log T(u)$, which appears when the level term is brought to the same side as the height.
